mmsPrivacy.description:
Dictates if any player can use the island code or only the owner.
Possible values are Public (anyone can use it) and Private (only owner).

override_Playlist.description: Dictates how matchmaking will split up parties, handle backfill, etc.

matchmakingType.title: EMMSRulePreset
matchmakingType.description: Determines the type of matchmaking used on this island. FLEXIBLE TEAMS - Allows party members to be on any team to matchmake quickly and keep games full. OFF - Disables matchmaking on this island.

matchmakingPrivacy.title: EMMSPrivacy
matchmakingPrivacy.description: PUBLIC - Anyone can use the island code. PRIVATE - Only the owner of the island can use the code.

maxPlayers.description: Maximum number of players allowed into the game.

creativeMatchmakingPrivacy.title: EIslandQueuePrivacy
creativeMatchmakingPrivacy.description: Determines if players can choose between Public Only and Private Only or are restricted to one or the other. Private games alter the behavior of some options from how they are set in Island settings. For example the social party will be evenly distributed across teams regardless of island settings, and parties won't have the ability to Fill regardless of the value of Fill Option.

islandMatchmakingPrivacy.title: EIslandQueuePrivacy
islandMatchmakingPrivacy.description: *DEPRECATED* Determines if players can choose between Public Only and Private Only or are restricted to one or the other. Private games alter the behavior of some options from how they are set in Island settings. For example the social party will be evenly distributed across teams regardless of island settings, and parties won't have the ability to Fill regardless of the value of Fill Option.

joinInProgress.title: CreativeTeamOption
joinInProgress.description: *DEPRECATED* Specifies what to do when a player joins while a game is in progress. Set to SPAWN if you want players to join in progress.

teamType.title: ECreativeTeamType
teamType.description: What type of team are we?

teamIndex.description:
Which team index are we?
Only used when TeamType == TeamIndex.

socialJoining.title: ESocialJoiningType
socialJoining.description: Determines if a new player can join a session in-progress when joining a friend or being invited to the game. This does not affect private matches.

joinInProgressBehavior.title: EJoinInProgressBehavior
joinInProgressBehavior.description: Determines how a new player is handled when they join an in-progress match.

bJoinInProgressAssignedTeamOverride.description: Allows the team a join in progress player is assigned to be overridden.

joinInProgressAssignedTeam.description: The team that a player will be assigned to when joining in progress.

bForceStartAtMaxPlayers.description: Force the game to start when it reaches the maximum player count

bUseCustomMatchmakingSettings.description: Allows you to override the generated matchmaking properties derived from various game rules. While this value is false, the matchmaking values update dynamically with game rules.

matchmaking_MaxPlayersPerSession.description: Maximum number of players matchmaking will allow to join a session.

matchmaking_MaxTeamCount.description: The number of teams the session expects to have.

matchmaking_MaxTeamSize.description: The maximum number of players allowed per team. If this is set to -1 it means that the Game will handle team maximums dynamically.

matchmaking_MaxSocialPartySize.description: Maximum number of players allowed in a party when players attempt to queue for this experience.

matchmaking_MinPlayers.description: This is the number of players required to start a game session. At the end of the Overtime Phase, the queue will be cancelled if it has not reached this many players. (Only applies to public matches)

matchmaking_OvertimePlayerTarget.description: The target number of players that will trigger the queue to send players to a match during the queue's overtime phase. (Only applies to public matches)

matchmaking_QueueMainDuration.description: Determines how long the Main Phase for matchmaking will last. During the queue's main phase, the queue will attempt to achieve a full match. (Only applies to public matches)

matchmaking_QueueOvertimeDuration.description: Determines how long the queue's Overtime Phase for matchmaking will last. During the overtime phase, the queue will attempt to reach the Overtime Player Target. (Only applies to public matches)
